name: Tessellate
description: A local-first notebook where a local AI files your notes, links them and answers questions with every sentence cited to its source. 100% offline, no account, no telemetry, one SQLite file. Python, FastAPI, vanilla JS.

paragraphs: Capture anything. Ask anything. Tessellate files it, links it and answers from it, all on your own device.

Tessellate is in beta. It works and it is tested, but some parts are still rough: you may meet lag in places (long note lists, the graph and mind maps), screens that need more polish, and features that are planned but not built yet. Your notes stay on your machine and are kept safe by backups, but please keep your own copy of anything important while we are in beta. We are working through the rough edges release by release, so updates come often. If something is slow, broken or missing, open an issue and say what you were doing: it is the fastest way to get it fixed.
Installed it before it was called Tessellate? Open this first.
